title: Engineering Manager - App Stores
description:
Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder‑led, profitable, and growing.

This is a technical management role to lead a team that develops Python and Golang micro‑services that power our global software distribution engine. The world sees it as the Snap Store and Charmhub.io marketplaces; behind the scenes it is a unified system that understands key concepts in software distribution – architectures, releases, betas, release candidates, stable releases, branches and more. We are on a journey to transform the experience that people all over the world have with their open source software by significantly expanding the range of software we can deliver through this system. If you have a passion for clean APIs, believe that great engineers ship software calmly and regularly against an agile plan, and know that tests are the key to higher velocity and reliability, you'll fit right in.

This is a great opportunity to take part in engineering a highly scalable SaaS product (think about the load on our systems when one of our largest Ubuntu Desktop snaps is updated by the publisher, for instance). In addition, you will have the opportunity to learn from Canonical's world‑class security team as we work collectively to deliver this capability, safely, to our customers around the world.

As an Engineering Manager at Canonical, you must be technically strong, but your main responsibility is to run an effective team and develop the colleagues you manage. You will develop and review code as a leader, but know that the best way to improve the product is to ensure that the whole team is focused, productive and unblocked. You are expected to help them grow as engineers, do meaningful work, do it outstandingly well, find professional and personal satisfaction, and work well with colleagues and the community. You will also be expected to be a positive influence on culture, facilitate technical delivery, and regularly reflect with your team on strategy and execution. You will collaborate closely with other Engineering Managers, product managers, and architects, producing an engineering roadmap with ambitious and achievable goals.

We expect Engineering Managers to be fluent in the programming language, architecture, and components that their team uses. Code reviews and architectural leadership are part of the job. The commitment to healthy engineering practices, documentation, quality and performance optimisation is as important, as is the requirement for fair and clear management, and the obligation to ensure a high‑performing team.

Location

This role may be based remotely in the Americas, Europe, Middle East or Africa time zones.

What your day will look like

  • Lead a remote team of engineers in your time zone
  • Develop talent through coaching, mentoring, feedback, and hands‑on career development
  • Set and manage expectations with other engineering teams, management, and external stakeholders
  • Be an active part of the leadership team and collaborate with other leaders in the organisation
  • With your team, build clean web service APIs to support both CLI and web frontend clients, using Python (and optionally Golang).
  • Engage with many other teams at Canonical, as well as the open‑source community and commercial partners

What we are looking for in you

  • Good experience in leading modern, agile software development practices
  • Experience in forming a healthy, collaborative engineering culture in line with the company values
  • Demonstrative experience of being a role model for sound engineering principles and directly contributing toward your team's goals
  • Willingness to travel up to 4 times a year for internal events
  • You love to mentor, develop and grow people, and have a track record of doing it
  • You are knowledgeable and passionate about software development
  • You are focused on success and the timely delivery of high‑quality software
  • You value and nurture great team culture and spirit
  • You have experience and commitment to agile development methodologies
  • Software development experience in Python (experience in Golang in addition to that would be a big plus)
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Practical experience with Linux system administration

What we offer you

Your base pay will depend on various factors including your geographical location, level of experience, knowledge and skills. In addition to the benefits above, certain roles are also eligible for additional benefits and rewards including annual bonuses and sales incentives based on revenue or utilisation. Our compensation philosophy is to ensure equity right across our global workforce.

In addition to a competitive base pay, we provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. Please note that additional benefits may apply depending on the work location and, for more information on these, you can ask in the later stages of the recruitment process.

  • Fully remote working environment – we've been working remotely since 2004!
  • Personal learning and development budget of 2,000 USD per annum
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Parental leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues at 'sprints'
  • Priority Pass for travel and travel upgrades for long‑haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open‑source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer. We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

title: Corrosion Engineer - Relocate to Saudi Arabia, Permanent Expat Relocation Package
description:
This position requires full relocation to Saudi Arabia. It is a permanent full time Expat family relocation package.

Job Overview

We are seeking a corrosion engineer to join the Southern Area Asset Integrity Division (SAAID) of SAOP Technical Support Department.

SAAID is responsible for providing effective and proactive corrosion management support to safeguard assets while adopting best industry practices and cutting-edge technologies.

Your primary role is to perform integrity and corrosion analysis studies to assess current challenges and develop a mitigation plan by implementing cost effective solutions and deployment of advanced and proven technologies to prevent or significantly reduce the impact of corrosion. This is to be supported with benchmarking and implementation of strategies that will enhance the long‑term reliability and asset efficiency of our assets.

Key Responsibilities

  • Perform periodical analytical study of corrosion assessment findings to overcome challenging inspection programs
  • Research and Deploy emerging Technologies related to corrosion mitigation and non‑metallic deployment.
  • Act as expert corrosion and asset integrity management resource for corrosion risk assessment and mitigation.
  • Develop Pipeline Integrity Plans (PIP) aligned with the organization integrity performance objectives, assigning responsibilities, and timeframes for the responsible stakeholder.
  • Develop annual condition assessment schedule in line with the PIP recommendations.
  • Review PIP trends and initiate detailed engineering studies accordingly (e.g. increase in internal corrosion features, encroachment to pipelines, low quality of ILI reports, failure investigations, etc.)
  • Facilitate the investigation of corrosion failure and deploy lesson learned from the root cause analysis to the system to avoid reoccurrence.
  • Perform periodical analytical study of assessment findings to overcome challenging inspection programs.
  • Evaluate the QA findings and perform periodical analytical study of assessment findings to overcome challenging inspection programs.
  • Provide consultation on specialized area related to corrosion control.
  • Perform integrity and corrosion analysis studies to assess current challenges.
  • Monitor the corrosion parameters such PH, O2, bacteria, residual of biocide chemical, and take corrective actions accordingly.
  • Review the inspection data and make corrosion control recommendations/reports accordingly.
  • Review laboratory data/parameters and issue the recommendations accordingly.
  • Apply corrosion monitoring system/program to ensure the integrity & reliability of the plant assets.

Qualifications

  • Hold a Bachelor’s degree in corrosion Engineering from a recognized and approved program. An advanced degree is preferred.
  • Have 15 years‑experience in corrosion engineering, including at least three years as senior corrosion engineer.
  • Must have a comprehensive knowledge of corrosion principles, including electrochemistry, material properties, corrosion mechanisms, and corrosion prevention methods.
  • Should also have sufficient background in various laboratory and field‑testing techniques used to assess corrosion behavior, such as accelerated corrosion testing, electrochemical corrosion monitoring, and non‑destructive testing methods.
  • Familiarity with corrosion prevention and control strategies, including material selection, protective coatings, cathodic protection, corrosion inhibitors, and corrosion monitoring systems is a requirement.
  • Understanding of industry standards and codes related to corrosion, such as National Association of Corrosion Engineers (NACE), American Society for Testing and Materials (ASTM) International standards, and API (American Petroleum Institute) standards.
  • Practical experience through entry‑level positions or corrosion engineering roles in industries such as oil and gas, aerospace, chemical processing, marine, or infrastructure.
  • Demonstrate effective analytical and communication skills to collaborate with multidisciplinary teams, prepare technical reports, and present findings to stakeholders.
  • Awareness about the latest advancements in corrosion science and technologies through professional development courses, certifications, workshops, conferences, and memberships in relevant industry organizations.

Working environment

title: Engineering Manager- Ceph & Distributed Storage
description:
Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder‑led, profitable, and growing.

We are hiring an Engineering Manager for Ceph & Distributed Storage. The world creates more than 2.5 quintillion bytes of data every day! We want to help teams to store data in open source storage on commodity hardware — safely, cheaply and simply.

Our goal is to make Ceph easy to install, manage and use — from large enterprise data center installations to half‑rack edge sites. We believe that distributed storage shouldn't be hard — and to keep up with the increasing data storage demands, it needs to be easier than ever before. We have a range of tools to bring to bear on the problem, and we're excited to make distributed Ceph easy enough that everyone does it.

As an engineering manager at Canonical you must be technically strong, but your responsibility is to run an effective team and develop the colleagues you manage. You are expected to help them grow as engineers, do important work, do it outstandingly well, find professional and personal satisfaction, and work well with colleagues and community. Technical leadership experience and a background in software engineering are necessary prerequisites for this role. You will be expected to lead, challenge, and develop strong engineers, positively influence the culture, facilitate technical delivery, and work with your team on strategy and execution. You will be responsible for sound software architecture and best practices in software quality, testing and documentation.

What you'll do

  • You will lead a team building a Ceph focused software defined storage solution
  • You will build and manage a globally distributed team of engineers
  • You'll develop your team through coaching, mentoring and feedback
  • You will demonstrate sound engineering principles by directly contributing toward your team's goals
  • Set reasonable schedules based on considered estimates, with feedback loops for improvement
  • Set and manage expectations with other engineering teams and external stakeholders
  • Advance modern, agile software development practices
  • Maintain a culture of quality and engineering excellence
  • Grow a healthy, collaborative engineering culture in line with the company values
  • Be an active part of the leadership team and collaborate with other leaders in the organisation
  • Work from home with global travel up to 20% for internal and external events

Who you are

  • You have a software engineering background, preferably with Python and C++ experience
  • You have experience operating scale out storage clusters on Linux in production environments, preferably with Ceph
  • You love embracing new technologies and pushing the boundaries of what is possible
  • You love developing and growing people and have a track record of doing it
  • You have an interest in building products that improve how people operate software and infrastructure everywhere
  • You are knowledgeable and passionate about software development
  • You have experience in leading, managing, coaching and mentoring software developers towards delivering timely, high quality software together
  • You have solid experience working in an agile development environment

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open‑source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Entregar soluções de engenharia confiáveis e eficientes, apoiando nossos clientes na execução de projetos complexos com excelência técnica e segurança.

This is a full-time position. The role requires strong low-level technical skills, such as C++ programming, working with network protocols, or reverse engineering. If your experience is mainly in web hacking, you should instead apply for the on-demand penetration testing position, which focuses more on web security.

  • Perform penetration tests on PC, mobile, and console games

  • Basic web hacking knowledge

Working knowledge

  • Unreal Engine (UE4/UE5, UE4SS), Unity, dnSpy, il2cpp

Benefits

  • A competitive salary

If this sounds interesting to you and you\'d like to be at the forefront of cybersecurity, we\'d love to hear from you.

Trabalhar na Norsul é fazer parte da maior empresa privada de cabotagem do Brasil — e contribuir, todos os dias, com o que mantém essa estrutura viva, confiável e em movimento.

Mesmo fora do mar, você está a bordo: garantindo que processos funcionem, decisões aconteçam e a operação siga com consistência, segurança e cuidado.

Aqui, o impacto não está só nos navios — está também em cada planilha, em cada conversa, em cada escolha feita com atenção e responsabilidade.

O que você entrega faz diferença. E o jeito como você entrega também.

Fazer parte

É mais do que estar na maior empresa privada de cabotagem do Brasil — é fazer parte de um time que cuida do que faz e de quem faz acontecer.

Aqui, as relações importam. O respeito, a escuta e o apoio entre as pessoas são parte do trabalho, todos os dias.

Não buscamos perfeição nem fórmulas prontas. O que conta é o compromisso em construir junto, com responsabilidade, clareza e parceria.

A cultura da Norsul não está só nos valores escritos, mas nas atitudes de quem trabalha a bordo, no porto ou no escritório.

Ela se revela no jeito de colaborar, de ensinar, de aprender — e de manter a operação fluindo com confiança mútua.

Com mais de 60 anos de história, transportamos bauxita, minério de ferro, celulose e muito mais — conectando rotas no Brasil e no exterior, com segurança, consistência e compromisso com um futuro mais sustentável.

Nosso trabalho movimenta o país, gera impacto positivo e transforma a vida de quem faz parte dele. Seja qual for o seu papel nessa jornada, o que você faz tem impacto.

Aqui, ninguém caminha sozinho. Cada pessoa importa. Cada trajetória tem valor.

Toda escala, travessia ou rotina é vivida com respeito e presença — e é isso que sustenta tudo o que a gente entrega.

title: Analista de Infraestrutura de TI II
description:
Rio de Janeiro-RJ

Buscamos um profissional de Infraestrutura de TI, capaz de administrar e evoluir ambientes on-premises e em nuvem, garantindo disponibilidade, segurança e desempenho dos serviços, com sólida base em Windows, Linux, redes, virtualização e segurança, além de interesse em automação, padronização e boas práticas, boa comunicação e capacidade de atuar de forma colaborativa apoiando a modernização contínua da infraestrutura e o crescimento do negócio.

Atribuições principais:

  • Prestar suporte aos usuários nos atendimentos de média complexidade;
  • Garantir o funcionamento do software e hardware de toda infraestrutura de redes, servidor, banco de dados de um projeto ou sistema;
  • Realizar a manutenção preventivas para garantir a segurança de dados;
  • Criar políticas de backup e segurança;
  • Prevenir contra invasões físicas ou lógicas e mapear todos esses procedimentos técnicos;
  • Instalar, configurar e atualizar softwares, esclarecendo dúvidas e fornecendo requisitos necessários para o funcionamento adequado de infraestruturas de redes;
  • Ser interface com o time de sustentação e participar de reuniões técnicas e de crise para resolução de incidentes críticos;
  • Documentar procedimentos pertinentes a operação de monitoração e suporte de TI;
  • Criar usuários nos sistemas e fazer manutenção de grupos para concessão de privilégios com permissão de acesso;
  • Levantar feedbacks sobre processos visando melhoria contínua;
  • Zelar pelo atendimento ao usuário e por manter a lista de atendimentos dentro do SLA.

Requisitos:

  • Administração de ambientes Windows Server, incluindo Active Directory (AD), DNS, DHCP, Group Policy Objects (GPO) e WSUS.
  • Administração de sistemas Linux (Debian, CentOS, Ubuntu ou RedHat), com experiência em gerenciamento de permissões, pacotes e shell scripting (Bash).
  • Domínio de protocolos de rede, incluindo TCP/IP, roteamento, sub-redes e VLANs.
  • Conhecimento em hardware de rede, com configuração de switches (Cisco, HP, Dell), roteadores e Access Points.
  • Experiência na configuração e suporte a serviços de rede, como VPN (IPsec, OpenVPN), Proxy e balanceadores de carga.
  • Vivência com serviços em nuvem, incluindo gestão de instâncias (EC2/VMs), armazenamento (S3/Blob Storage) e redes virtuais (VPC).
  • Conhecimento em virtualização, utilizando ferramentas como VMware vSphere/ESXi, Microsoft Hyper-V ou Nutanix.
  • Experiência em storage, com gerenciamento de ambientes NAS e SAN, protocolos iSCSI e Fibre Channel, além da gestão de LUNs.
  • Configuração e administração de firewalls, como Fortinet, Cisco ASA, pfSense ou SonicWall.
  • Implementação e gestão de rotinas de backup, políticas de retenção e ferramentas como Veeam Backup & Replication, Veritas ou Commvault.
  • Experiência com monitoramento de ambientes, utilizando ferramentas como Zabbix, Nagios, Grafana ou PRTG.

Diferenciais:

  • Conhecimento básico em Infrastructure as Code (IaC), com utilização de ferramentas como Terraform ou Ansible.
  • Noções de containers, incluindo Docker e Kubernetes.
  • Conhecimento em linguagens de script, como PowerShell ou Python, para automação de tarefas rotineiras.

Localidade da posição:

Híbrido no Rio de Janeiro/RJ

A SPDM - Associação Paulista para o Desenvolvimento da Medicina é uma Associação civil sem fins lucrativos, de natureza filantrópica, reconhecida de utilidade pública federal, estadual e no município de sua sede, respectivamente pelos decretos nos. 57.925, de 04/03/1966, 40.103 de 17/05/1962 e 8.911, de 30/07/1970. A Instituição atua nos âmbitos federal, estadual e municipal, em harmonia com suas políticas de saúde e de educação, e também como organização social habilitada em vários estados, na gerência de serviços e organizações de saúde, por meio de convênios e contratos de gestão. Com o crescimento Institucional, a SPDM vem expandindo sua área de atuação com projetos, em desenvolvimento, na área da Assistência Social e na área Educacional. Toda essa gama de atividades consolida, cada vez mais, a SPDM como uma instituição filantrópica de grande porte, que busca a sustentabilidade econômica, social e ambiental. Suas quatro superintendências - Hospital São Paulo, Instituições Afiliadas, Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde (PAIS) e Educação - são gerenciadas por profissionais de alta capacitação técnica e notável saber.

DESCRIÇÃO

Quer fazer parte de uma das maiores redes de clínicas odontológicas do Brasil?

Há mais de 39 anos no mercado, o Grupo Clínicas Inteligentes é uma das maiores redes de clínicas odontológicas, presente em mais de 20 estados, formado por 4 marcas com a colaboração de 2100 colaboradores e um dos melhores corpos clínicos do Brasil. Com conceito de clínica popular, somos determinados a garantir o pronto atendimento em ambientes seguros, confortáveis e climatizados por um valor justo e acessível. Acreditamos que o atendimento humanizado contagia e motiva a todos que se relacionam conosco.

O Grupo Clínicas Inteligentes informa que sua participação em nossos processos seletivos é gratuita e nenhum fornecedor ou terceiro está autorizado a cobrar valores para candidatura à vaga, treinamento, material didático ou qualquer outra despesa relacionada.

Sobre a Oportunidade

Realiza coleta dos materiais nos consultórios para esterilização diária e guarda em lugar específico, para utilização dos profissionais / Dentistas; realiza a Limpeza e higienização dos consultórios (cadeiras, cuspideiras, entre outros itens) e confere diariamente os equipamentos (consultórios, central de esterilização/autoclaves) a fim de que estejam em perfeito funcionamento, comunicando irregularidades ao responsável imediato e formalizando solicitações de manutenção junto ao movdesk (ferramenta específica da empresa). Realiza as atividades seguindo as regras de segurança do trabalho e garantindo atendimento às normas de fiscalização e vigilância sanitária. Recepciona pacientes no consultório dentário, procurando identificá-las e averiguar suas necessidades, para prestar informações ou encaminhá-las ao cirurgião-dentista. Executa tarefas auxiliares ao trabalho do cirurgião-dentista, visando a agilização dos serviços. Auxilia o profissional no atendimento aos pacientes, em tarefas como segurar o sugador de saliva, fazer o afastamento lingual e alcançar materiais e instrumentos odontológicos, manipular material provisório e definitivo utilizado para restauração dentária. Prepara o material anestésico, de sutura, polimento, bem como procede à troca de brocas, separa o material e instrumentos clínicos em bandejas para serem utilizados pelo profissional. Zelar pela boa manutenção de equipamentos e peças, preparar, acondicionar e esterilizar materiais e equipamentos utilizados. Colaborar com a limpeza e organização do local de trabalho (consultórios, sala de esterilização e infecção). Realizar o controle dos materiais no estoque, solicitar materiais via sistema, cotação e compra dos materiais emergenciais para a clínica. Executar outras atividades correlatas ao cargo e/ou determinadas pelo superior.

Precisa possuir o curso de ASB + CRO ativo.

Horário: Segunda à sexta das 09h às 18h e sábado das 09h às 13h.

  • Pontualidade

  • Agilidade

title: Roaming IREG Engineer - Lisbon-based
description:
Position Overview

1Global is seeking a talented and detail-oriented Roaming IREG Engineer to manage the entire roaming process and procedures. As an IREG Engineer you will be responsible for the technical setup, testing, and maintenance of international roaming and interconnect services. We are looking for a proactive individual with a strong technical foundation, adept at troubleshooting support cases and enhancing operational processes for seamless footprint updates.

This is a Lisbon-based position, and relocation will be required. Relocation support may be provided for the selected candidate.

Key Responsibilities

  • Plan, execute, and document IREG tests (IR.24, IR.35, IR.50, etc.) for voice, SMS, and data services, in line with GSMA standards
  • Set up and verify interconnect links for voice and messaging services with partner operators
  • Monitor roaming service KPIs, troubleshoot issues, and ensure compliance with roaming agreements
  • Configure and test SS7, Diameter, SIP, and related signaling protocols for international connectivity
  • Liaise with foreign operators, roaming hubs, and internal teams during implementation and troubleshooting
  • Maintain up-to-date test results, network configurations, and operational procedures
  • Oversee the footprint management of all 1Global products, working closely with the wholesale and other networks team

Requirements

Must Have

  • Perform end-to-end roaming testing (voice, SMS, data, CAMEL, VoLTE, 5G roaming)
  • Execute IREG test cases according to GSMA guidelines and bilateral agreements
  • Analyze and troubleshoot roaming issues with signaling traces and logs
  • Work closely with international roaming partners to resolve interconnect problems
  • Manage and update roaming documentation (IR.21)
  • Support new roaming launches (testing and activation of new operators, technologies, and services)
  • Coordinate with internal teams (Core Network, Billing, etc) during testing and troubleshooting
  • Validate TAP files and charging/billing aspects of roaming services
  • Monitor KPIs and performance of roaming services after launch
  • Follow-up and define Quality and Performance indicators for the entire roaming service
  • Maintain close relationships with external partners like carriers and service providers

Qualifications

  • Degree in Telecom Engineering or Computer Science or equivalent experience
  • Knowledge of 3GPP, ETSI, standards and specifications for SIM/eSIM
  • Knowledge and experience with protocols such as MAP, S6a
  • Familiar with an RSP architecture and experience operating it
  • Knowledge in scripting and have basic programming skills
  • Experience with protocol analyzer tools like Wireshark, Astelia, and ability to use them to troubleshoot networks errors/problems for the mentioned protocols
  • Experience with ETSI NFV architecture and solutions
  • Familiar with MVNO/MVNE/MVNA architecture(s) and landscape

Benefits

  • CLT contract — enjoy job stability and reliable benefits that value your work
  • Quarterly performance bonuses
  • Meal allowance paid into Caju card — R$100 per working day
  • Health insurance with SulAmérica — 50% covered by the company
  • Daycare allowance provided to mothers with children under 3 years old — R$500 per month per child
  • Welcome onboarding trip to one of our European offices (Lisbon or Berlin)

Why 1GLOBAL?

  • Growth Opportunities: Advance your career in one of the fastest growing telecommunications companies
  • Major Transaction Exposure: Be in the driver's seat for transactions that will impact the future telco industry
  • Work with a Talented Team: Collaborate with leaders and external advisors in a dynamic environment
  • Dynamic Work Environment: A collaborative, fast-paced workplace where innovation is encouraged
  • Professional Development: Enhance your skills in a cutting-edge field
  • International Experience: Opportunities to work in different 1GLOBAL offices around the world
  • Open Communication Culture: An environment where ideas are heard and dialogue is encouraged
  • Get Things Done Attitude: A results-driven team that values impact

1GLOBAL is an equal opportunity employer and values diversity. We offer a collaborative, dynamic, and international work environment.

The Company You’ll Join

Carta connects founders, investors, and limited partners through world-class software, purpose-built for everyone in venture capital, private equity and private credit. Trusted by 65,000+ companies in 160+ countries, Carta’s platform of software and services lays the groundwork so you can build, invest, and scale with confidence.

Carta’s Fund Administration platform supports 9,000+ funds and SPVs, representing nearly $185B in assets under management, with tools designed to enhance the strategic impact of fund CFOs. Recognized by Fortune, Forbes, Fast Company, Inc. and Great Places to Work, Carta is shaping the future of private market infrastructure.

Together, Carta is creating the end-to-end ERP platform for private markets. Traditional ERP solutions don’t work for Private Funds. Private capital markets need a comprehensive software solution to replace outdated spreadsheets and fragmented service providers. Carta’s software for the Office of the Fund CFO does just that - it’s a new category of software to make private markets look more like public markets - a connected ERP for private capital.

For more information about our offices and culture, check out our Carta careers page.

The Team You’ll Work With

The Data Ops team is focused on delivering high-quality, auditable data to our customers. You will work within a team dedicated to reducing customer effort and empowering clients to take actionable insights from their private markets data.

The Problems You’ll Solve

As a Data Ops Analyst, you will be responsible for the lifecycle of quarterly data extraction and client reporting. Your primary objective is to ensure that extracted data is high-quality, timely, and actionable for our customers.

Your core responsibilities will include:

  • Quarterly Data Extraction: Manage the extraction of private markets data from accounting documents and performance reports.
  • Quality & Timeliness: Ensure all data is extracted in a timely manner and meets our high standards for data quality.
  • Customer Support: Provide timely and accurate front-line support for all customers that your segment services.
  • Active Engagement: Proactively follow up with clients during each quarterly data campaign, providing clear tracking of what data is complete and ready for client review.
  • Real-time Interaction: Engage with clients in real-time via phone or Zoom to resolve issues and guide them through their data.
  • Process Improvement: Keep detailed documentation of client interactions to identify trends and drive operational and process improvements for the data ops team and the product teams.
  • Project Management: Treat every data campaign as a project, ensuring all stakeholders are updated on progress and milestones.
  • Subject Matter Expertise: Become an expert in private markets data, including financial metrics and KPIs.

About You

  • Communication: Fluent in English with the ability to articulate technical and complex concepts in a clear and concise manner.
  • Analytical Skills: Knowledge of financial statements and common financial concepts with a strong sense of curiosity to solve problems.
  • Organization: Highly organized with strong attention to detail and the ability to balance multiple active projects with competing priorities.
  • Client Service: Care deeply and genuinely about client services; you exhibit diplomacy, tact, and poise under pressure.
  • Adaptability: Comfortable learning new technologies and platforms quickly in a fast-paced environment.

Cambly is transforming how the world learns English. Nice to Have

  • Familiarity with AI tools for content optimization and SEO research

title: Sr Business Development Manager, Flights LATAM
description:
About the job

As a Business Development Manager, Airline Partnerships, you will support and grow relationships with a portfolio of airline distribution partners, helping to drive revenue growth and long-term collaboration.

You will represent the company in day‑to‑day airline partner interactions, working closely with internal teams to execute commercial initiatives, support partner needs, and contribute to enterprise growth goals. This role requires a mix of account management, sales execution, and analytical skills.

At Hopper, you can have an immediate impact in a high‑growth environment. Airline sales and distribution is a specialized field, so prior experience in airline distribution (OTA, TMC, GDS, airline, etc.) is a strong plus, particularly within the LATAM market.

Successful candidates will be able to clearly communicate Hopper’s value proposition and effectively position our products and capabilities to airline partners.

What your day‑to‑day would look like:

  • Support the management of a portfolio of airline accounts, contributing to growth strategies and execution plans
  • Track partner performance, analyze results, and help identify risks and growth opportunities
  • Build a strong understanding of partner business objectives and assist in developing initiatives aligned with their strategy
  • Identify opportunities to improve commercial relationships and collaborate with internal teams to address them
  • Help organize and participate in quarterly business reviews with airline partners
  • Partner with finance teams to support forecasting and revenue tracking for airline partnerships
  • Assist in developing and executing marketing initiatives and insertion orders (I/Os) with airline partners in support of growth goals
  • Support contract negotiations, renewals, and amendments in collaboration with senior team members
  • Act as a liaison between airline partners and internal teams to ensure smooth operational execution and a strong traveler experience
  • Develop a working knowledge of the global travel market, with a focus on airline industry dynamics.

An ideal candidate has

  • 3–5 years of experience in sales, business development, or account management with a track record of supporting revenue growth
  • Prior experience in airline distribution (OTA, TMC, GDS, or airline), with exposure to or experience in the LATAM market preferred
  • Familiarity with commercial, cultural, and regulatory dynamics of the LATAM travel ecosystem
  • A positive, proactive, and self‑motivated attitude
  • Ability to prepare and deliver clear, data‑driven presentations
  • A collaborative, team‑first mindset
  • Strong organizational, prioritization, and time management skills
  • A detail‑oriented and analytical approach to problem‑solving
  • Passion for travel, technology, and digital commerce
  • Foundational value‑selling skills and commercial acumen
  • Comfort working in a fast‑paced, evolving environment
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in both English & Portuguese

Perks and benefits of working with us:

  • Well‑funded and proven startup with large ambitions, competitive salary and the upsides of pre‑IPO equity packages.
  • Carrot Cash travel stipend.
  • Hopper will cover 100% of the employee premiums for EOR‑offered health, dental, life and short term disability insurances with SulAmerica.
  • Hopper offers employees in Brazil monthly meal vouchers
  • Very generous parental leave
  • Flexdesk All Access Pass & Work‑from‑home stipend.
  • Entrepreneurial culture where pushing limits and taking risks is everyday business.
  • Open communication with management and company leadership.
  • Small, dynamic teams = massive impact.

More about Hopper

At Hopper, we are on a mission to become the leading travel platform globally – powering Hopper’s mobile app, website and our B2B business, HTS (Hopper Technology Solutions). By leveraging massive amounts of data and advanced machine learning algorithms, Hopper combines its world‑class travel agency offering with proprietary fintech products to bring transparency, flexibility and savings to travelers globally. We have developed several unique fintech solutions that address everything from pricing volatility to trip disruptions – helping people travel better and save more on their trips.

The Hopper platform serves hundreds of millions of travelers globally and continues to capture market share around the world. The Hopper app has been downloaded over 120 million times and has become largely popular among younger travelers – with 70% of its users being Gen Z and millennials.

While everyone knows us as the Gen Z and Millennial travel app, Hopper has evolved to become much more than that. In recent years, we’ve grown into a travel fintech provider, commerce platform, and global travel agency that powers some of the world’s largest brands.

Through HTS, our B2B division, the company supercharges its partners’ direct channels by integrating our fintech products on their sites or powering end‑to‑end travel portals. Today, our partners include leading travel brands like Capital One, Nubank, Air Canada, and many more.

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ ("FWWC2027") that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Department

Strategy & Planning

Location

Brazil

The Position

Reporting to the Executive Director of Legacy and Stakeholder Affairs, the FWWC2027 Legacy Manager will oversee all matters related to the development, implementation and reporting of the FWWC 2027 Legacy Programme in close collaboration and with strategic guidance from the Women’s Football Division in FIFA.

Key Responsibilities

  • Oversee and implement the FWWC 2027 Legacy Programme with the objective of delivering together with all relevant stakeholders a coordinated, long‑lasting and tangible impact on the host country and region after hosting the event.
  • Coordinate the legacy activities of the CBF, FIFA and any other stakeholders related to the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027.
  • Bring to life the FWWC 2027 legacy framework consisting of three core pillars:
    1. Women’s Football Legacy: work with CBF, host cities and relevant stakeholders to build a positive legacy on the women’s football landscape in Brazil and the region.
    2. Social Impact Legacy: work with CBF, the Brazilian Federal Government, State Governments, NGOs and other relevant stakeholders to identify, build and implement a lasting social impact leveraging the FWWC 2027 with a particular focus on gender‑based violence and improving the position of women in Brazilian society.

  • Support the Women’s Football Division on any other matters related to the FWWC 2027 Legacy programme as and when required.

Legacy Development

Communication & Stakeholder Relations

  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills to liaise with high‑level stakeholders, including government officials, commercial partners and media (when necessary).

Cultural Competency & Multinational Experience

  • Experience working in multinational environments and understanding cultural nuances when coordinating across countries.

Sobre o Hospital Municipal Pedro II

Desde dezembro de 2015, a SPDM/PAIS é responsável, em parceria com a Secretaria Municipal de Saúde do Rio de Janeiro, pelo gerenciamento do Hospital Municipal Pedro II .

A infraestrutura do Hospital conta com dez andares, nos quais estão distribuídos os serviços de emergência e de Unidade de Tratamento Intensivo (UTI) adulta, pediátrica e neonatal; maternidade; clínica médica, cirurgia-geral e bucomaxilofacial, neurocirurgia, psiquiatria, pediatria e ortopedia. Exames de imagem (raio X, tomografia, ultrassonografia, eletrocardiografia, ecocardiografia) e laboratoriais também são realizados na unidade.

Devido à grande população de idosos da Zona Oeste, região assistida pelo Hospital Municipal Pedro II (HMPII), há duas Enfermarias destinadas ao atendimento desse público.

O Centro de Tratamento de Queimados é outro diferencial entre os serviços oferecidos, e que dispõe de uma UTI exclusiva para prevenir infecções, que podem ser muito graves para quem está com queimaduras.

Além disso, a unidade conta com a Coordenação de Emergência Regional (CER) Santa Cruz, que possui 39 leitos, e tem como objetivo absorver as demandas de menor complexidade, deixando o HMPII liberado para os casos de risco iminente de morte, necessidade de cirurgia urgente e/ou internação. Um diferencial deste CER é o fato de possuir atendimento especializado em Psiquiatria e Obstetrícia.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Planejar, implementar e monitorar a distribuição de medicamentos, produtos e materiais nas diversas unidades do hospital, orientando sobre dados técnicos, tais como: dosagem, fórmula farmacêutica, composição química, substitutos etc; produzir; executar a guardar e controlar a distribuição de medicamentos; realizar controle diário dos estoques.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Ensino Superior Completo em Farmácia.
  • Especialização completa em uma ou mais das áreas citadas a seguir: Farmácia Clínica, Atenção Farmacêutica ou Residência Multiprofissional em Saúde.
  • Registro Ativo no Conselho da Classe.
  • Experiência mínima de 06 (seis) meses comprovada na função de Farmacêutico na área da saúde.

Informações adicionais

  • Local: Santa Cruz - RJ
  • Escala: 12H trabalhadas x 60H de descanso
  • Profissionais de empresas parceiras, fornecedores e/ou prestadores de serviços, vínculo com grau de parentesco ou afinidade no mesmo serviço ou que atuam em outra modalidade contratual (vínculo com o prestador), deverão observar normativas de RH vigentes, através de consulta junto ao setor de Recrutamento e Seleção.

description:
Resumo

Como é ser um Coordenador Médico de Suporte em MSF?

Você será responsável por apoiar o Coordenador Médico em tarefas administrativas e operacionais, contribuindo para uma gestão eficiente dos programas, fortalecendo a relação com autoridades e garantindo que as atividades sigam os protocolos da MSF. Seu trabalho será essencial para assegurar cuidados médicos de qualidade e melhorar a saúde da população atendida.

Responsabilidades

  • Saúde do Staff: manter atualizada a política nacional de saúde do staff, identificar e validar serviços de saúde de qualidade, elaborar POPs e diretrizes, e acompanhar casos individuais, garantindo acesso adequado aos serviços, bem como a coleta e arquivamento apropriado das informações médicas.
  • Gestão da Informação e Registros: assegurar que toda a documentação contendo informações médicas seja corretamente arquivada, em conformidade com princípios de confidencialidade e proteção de dados.
  • Preparação e Resposta a Emergências: apoiar o monitoramento de dados epidemiológicos, conduzir análises de situação com base em informações disponíveis e/ou avaliações de campo, contribuir para a atualização do plano de preparação e resposta a emergências e, quando necessário, participar de respostas de emergência realizando atividades clínicas em campo.
  • Apoio Técnico ao Projeto: oferecer suporte técnico remoto ao projeto com foco na tuberculose no sistema prisional, orientando a implementação de ferramentas técnicas da MSF, apoiando a análise de dados e contribuindo para o monitoramento e a avaliação da qualidade do cuidado.
  • Advocacy e Articulação Institucional: apoiar a elaboração de relatórios médicos para fins de advocacy, identificar atores estratégicos em coordenação com o Departamento de Advocacy e acompanhar o/a Coordenador(a) Médico(a) em reuniões institucionais com o SUS e outras organizações, quando solicitado.

Dia a dia

Como é o dia a dia da posição?

Requisitos

  • Diploma em Medicina e Registro no Conselho Regional de Medicina (CRM).
  • Formação ou experiência em medicina tropical e/ou saúde pública é um diferencial.
  • Experiência prévia com MSF e/ou outra ONG é um diferencial, assim como experiência de trabalho no SUS.
  • Experiência em contexto de emergência é um diferencial.
  • Fluência em português; inglês é um diferencial.

Competências necessárias

  • Compromisso em alcançar objetivos com excelência.
  • Capacidade de analisar situações e encontrar soluções eficazes.
  • Habilidade para dialogar, construir acordos e representar a organização com profissionalismo.
  • Capacidade de se adaptar a mudanças, ajustando prioridades, horários e tarefas conforme as necessidades do contexto.

Princípios e Cultura de Salvaguarda

A MSF busca pessoas comprometidas com uma cultura de salvaguarda, promovendo um ambiente seguro, ético e acolhedor para todas. Valorizamos profundamente a Diversidade, Equidade e Inclusão (DEI) em todas as nossas ações. Candidaturas alinhadas a esses valores serão altamente consideradas.

title: Quality Data Engineer (IDMC)
description:
Introduction

In this role, you'll work in one of our IBM Consulting Client Innovation Centers (Delivery Centers), where we deliver deep technical and industry expertise to a wide range of public and private sector clients around the world. Our delivery centers offer our clients locally based skills and technical expertise to drive innovation and adoption of new technology.

Your Role And Responsibilities

This position is for talented and experienced Data Test Engineer with a strong background in Informatica Intelligent Data Management Cloud (IDMC) . In this role, you will be responsible for ensuring the quality, reliability, volume, and accuracy of data across on‑prem and cloud environments. You will validate data migration, transformation, and integration processes using IDMC, collaborating with cross‑functional teams to ensure seamless data ingestion from multiple sources—including streaming technologies, cloud platforms, and various data stores—while maintaining the highest standards of data quality and consistency.

Essential Job Functions

  • Design, develop, and execute test plans and test cases for data pipelines and workflows built with IDMC.
  • Perform data validation and transformation testing to verify completeness, consistency, and accuracy between source and target.
  • Develop and maintain automated data validation frameworks using Python, SQL, and IDMC’s built‑in tools and APIs.
  • Implement data quality rules and support continuous integration through CI/CD pipelines.
  • Collaborate with development, operations, and infrastructure teams to identify and resolve data quality issues.
  • Document test plans, results, and findings in a structured and traceable manner.
  • Support testing activities related to data migration, profiling, analysis, and transformation.
  • Manage defect tracking and reporting, ensuring timely resolution and clear communication.
  • Contribute to process improvements and testing best practices within an Agile environment.
  • Apply IDMC coding skills, including creating end‑to‑end mappings with Filters, Routers, and Joiners.
  • Work with JSON structures, filters, and parsers to validate and transform data.
  • Apply basic Java knowledge to support custom code requirements.
  • Use Python to read and process data from various file formats, leveraging functions and libraries such as Pandas.

Technical Requirements

  • Strong background in software product development and delivery.
  • Solid expertise in SQL for data validation and transformation.
  • Proven ability to design and execute data test plans, scenarios, and cases, with clear documentation of results.
  • Strong knowledge of Informatica IDMC or related data management tools.
  • Experience with Azure Cloud technologies such as ADF and PySpark.
  • Proficiency in Python and data libraries (e.g., Pandas).
  • Ability to interpret and create System & Architecture diagrams.
  • Strong collaboration skills and ability to work effectively in cross‑functional teams.
  • Background in Agile methodologies and continuous improvement practices.

Minimum Position Qualifications / Education Requirements

  • A bachelor’s degree in computer science or related information technology field from an accredited institution or equivalent work experience.
  • 6+ years of software product development and delivery experience.
  • 5+ years of SQL experience.
  • 3+ years of IDMC tool or related experience.
  • 3+ years’ experience overseeing the development of data test plans, test scenarios, test cases, execution of test case and documentation of test results.
  • 2+ years of experience in some of the Azure Cloud tools: ADF, Pyspark.
  • Experience with Python and libraries like Pandas.
  • Ability to interpret and draw System & Architecture diagrams.
  • Familiar with latest cloud technologies.

TechnipFMC is committed to driving real change in the energy industry. Bring your unique energy to our team of more than 20,000 people worldwide, and discover a rewarding, fulfilling, and varied career that you can take in anywhere you want to go.

Job Purpose

The Senior Software Developper calls for an experienced, knowledgeable, and talented individual to design and develop software for the User Configurable Open System (UCOS) product.

As a senior software engineer, you will have an opportunity to apply your versatile embedded, systems, and application software development skills to UCOS’s expanding use in myriad industrial controls and automation systems and Industrial IoT.You will lead and collaborate with other engineers while contributing at all phases of the software development lifecycle.

Job Description

  • Architect, design, implement, test and deliver high quality, performant software products.
  • Work cross functionally with software, application, and quality engineers to ensure products meet engineering and client success criteria.
  • Actively participate in the definition and implementation of new processes and improvements
  • Identify and create new technologies and ideas to increase the organization’s intellectual property and to better address customer needs.
  • Present your designs and solutions to internal and external teams and review designs of software and quality engineers.
  • Develop test plans and test automation processes to increase automated functional tests.
  • Mentor team in development/test technologies, tools, and processes

You are meant for this job if:

  • Requires a Bachelor of Science degree or related
  • Expertise in software engineering
  • Expert experience in C/C++, developing embedded software and systems software
  • Deep knowledge of object-oriented programming and experience with at least one of (Java, C#, Python, Ruby)
  • Knowledge of containerization technologies (such as Docker), Kubernetes technologies (such K3S, Helm charts, Rancher), and IoT protocols (MQTT, REST API, Kafka)
  • Knowledge of cloud technologies such as AWS
  • Systems software programming knowledge of Windows and Linux OS
  • Working knowledge of Microsoft MFC (Microsoft Foundation Class), WPF, Qt, or similar GUI framework
  • Understanding of database technologies such as SQL, ODBC, and relational database schema design
  • Understanding of networking protocols (TCP/IP, UDP), wired interfaces (Ethernet, USB), and wireless interfaces (Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, Cell, Satellite)
  • Experience designing, building, and maintaining APIs for internal/external services
  • Exposure to the principals of Industrial Protocols, Platforms and APIs: OPC (DA & UA), Profibus, Profinet, Modbus (RTU, TCP, Enron), EtherIP, etc.
  • Exposure to serial communication protocols (I2C, RS-485, RS-232, CAN, SPI)
  • Exposure to industry standard embedded design and debugging tools is a plus (JTAG, protocol analyzers, emulators)
  • Exposure to Configuration Management tools (Version control, bug tracking, change management, automated builds, and coding standards)
  • Exposure to developing in agile and Iterative Software development processes
  • Excellent verbal and written communications skills

title: Lead Thumbnail Designer
description:
As the Lead Thumbnail Designer at Knwn Local, you'llbuild and develop a team of 5-10+ thumbnail designers who create scroll-stopping visuals that drive channel growth for America's top real estate leaders. This is aplayer-coach leadership role where you'll spend 60-80% of your time managing, mentoring, and building systems, and 20-40% hands-on designing complex projects.

You'llown design quality standards, team development, and creative operations across the agency, partnering closely with Pod Managers, Creative Director, and leadership on strategic initiatives. Your success is measured not by how many thumbnailsyou design, but by how wellyour team performs, grows, and delivers results that drive client success.

This role is perfect for someone wholoves developing designers as much as designing itself - someone who gets energized by building systems, coaching talent, and multiplying impact through others. If you want to stay purely hands-on without management responsibilities, this isn't the right fit.

Team Leadership & Development (50-70% of role)

  • Directly manage 5-8 thumbnail designers conducting weekly 1-on-1s focused on skill development and performance
  • Lead bi-weekly team design reviews with constructive feedback and best practice sharing
  • Build comprehensive onboarding programs and training materials for new designer hires
  • Create career development pathways with clear promotion criteria for design team members
  • Conduct performance reviews and manage accountability through the Clarify Instrument Coach Decide framework
  • Build 2-5+ year relationships with designers through proactive retention and engagement strategies
  • Conduct skip-level meetings with junior designers to assess team health and identify early warning signs

Creative Excellence & Standards (20-30% of role)

  • Design 15-30 high-impact thumbnails per month for VIP clients and complex projects
  • Own and evolve agency-wide creative quality standards, brand guidelines, and style guides
  • Establish QA processes that maintain 90%+ first-approval rate across all designers
  • Lead A/B testing strategy and performance analysis across the entire client portfolio
  • Serve as final creative approval for all thumbnails before client delivery
  • Drive creative innovation through monthly experimentation initiatives and "Good Flops"
  • Create and maintain design team's template library and asset management systems

Strategic Collaboration & Systems (10-20% of role)

  • Partner with Pod Managers on client strategy and creative direction for key accounts
  • Present creative strategy and performance insights in Monthly Client Strategy Calls with clients
  • Collaborate with executive leadership on agency-wide creative vision and initiatives
  • Build scalable workflows, capacity planning, and resource allocation systems
  • Create performance dashboards tracking team metrics (CTR, approval rates, turnaround times)
  • Document best practices, SOPs, and knowledge base for the design function
  • Contribute to quarterly planning, annual strategy summits, and company OKRs

REQUIREMENTS:

Leadership & Design Experience

  • 6+ years of professional design experience with2+ years managing creative teams
  • Proven track record leading, developing, and scaling design teams of 5+ people
  • Minimum3+ years creating high-performing YouTube thumbnails with proven CTR results
  • Experience hiring designers, conducting performance reviews, and managing accountability
  • Portfolio showcasing thumbnails that contributed to channel growth (include CTR data)
  • Comfortable with difficult conversations (performance issues, firing, conflict resolution)

Technical & Strategic Skills

  • Expert-level proficiency in Photoshop, Illustrator, and Figma (portfolio required)
  • Deep understanding of YouTube algorithms, CTR optimization, and viewer psychology
  • Data-driven approach with ability to interpret analytics and translate into design strategy
  • Experience with A/B testing methodologies, performance analysis, and optimization
  • Strong presentation skills for client-facing strategy calls and executive meetings
  • Understanding of creative team economics (capacity planning, resourcing, budgeting)
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication for feedback, presentations, and documentation
  • Demonstrated ability to give feedback that accelerates growth and elevates work quality
  • Extreme Ownership - Takes full accountability for team results; never blames or makes excuses
  • Beyond Excellence - Sets impossibly high standards and inspires team to exceed them
  • Proactive Curiosity - Anticipates problems, asks better questions, and stays ahead of needs
  • Mission Focus - Obsesses about client success and team development over personal recognition

RESULTS:

Team Performance

  • Your design team consistently maintains90%+ first-approval rate across all designers
  • Designer retention rate exceeds 85% annually with clear development and career progression
  • New designers productive at80% capacity within 30-60 days through your training systems
  • 100% of direct reports show measurable skill improvement quarter-over-quarter
  • Team operates at80-90% capacity utilization - productive output without burnout

Quality & Impact

  • Zero client escalations due to design quality issues or missed deadlines from your team
  • Agency-wide thumbnailCTR averages 5-10% (significantly above platform benchmarks)
  • 95%+ on-time delivery rate across your entire team's project portfolio
  • Design workflows, templates, and style guides documented and adopted agency-wide
  • Your team generates innovative thumbnail strategies that drive agency-wide adoption

Strategic Leadership

  • Design function viewed asstrategic partner by Pod Managers and leadership
  • Successfully contribute to client strategy with design insights that drive performance
  • Client satisfaction scores remain >4.5/5 for design quality and communication
  • At least1-2 designers promoted or advancement-ready annually due to your mentorship
  • Leadership views design as a strategic differentiator, not just an execution function

COMPENSATION & GROWTH:

Salary & Benefits

  • Starting Range: $42,000 - $72,000 USD/year depending on experience and team size managed
  • Fully Remote
  • Flexible Time Off policy & Company Wide Holiday Breaks (we trust you to manage your time and energy)
  • Professional development budget for courses, plugins, and creative tools
  • PotentialHealth Insurance Reimbursement (after 60-90 day trial period options including Medical, Dental, Vision)
  • Potential to earnMonthly wellness allowance
  • Potential to earnHome office stipend for equipment and software
  • Access to industry-leading tools, plugins, and AI-assisted editing software
  • Clear career progression with transparent promotion criteria

Performance Metrics You'll Own

  • Team Performance: Design Quality Score, First-Approval Rate (90%+), CTR performance
  • Team Development: Skill progression, promotion readiness, retention rate (85%+)
  • Operational Excellence: Capacity utilization (80-90%), on-time delivery (95%+)
  • Strategic Impact: Innovation initiatives, process improvements, client satisfaction (>4.5/5)

LOCATION:

  • 100% Remote

WHO WE ARE:

Knwn Local helps America's top real estate leaders (ranked by Wall Street Journal Real Trends) attract more clients and grow their brands through strategic YouTube presence. Our clients manage $30M-$300M+ real estate teams and brokerages.

We're scaling from 55+ to 200+ channels with the mission of helping agents dominate their local markets through long-form video content that builds trust and authority.

Our Core Values: Extreme Ownership, Beyond Excellence, Proactive Curiosity, Mission Focus

MAKE SURE YOU'RE COMFORTABLE WITH:

title: Project Manager - Ubuntu Embedded Systems
description:
Overview

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include leading public cloud and silicon providers and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution. The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.

Project Manager - Ubuntu Embedded Systems at Canonical is a Project Manager for Canonical's Devices business. This role is responsible for the coordination and completion of large, complex customer-facing projects, overseeing all aspects of project delivery and acting as the primary delivery liaison between Canonical's engineering teams and Canonical's customers.

You will be managing projects that involve the delivery of Ubuntu images on a wide variety of devices ranging from robots, edge gateways, and IoT devices to PCs and automotive systems. This is a high-profile project management position where you are expected to build and maintain working relationships with team members, customers, other partners/vendors (silicon vendors, OEMs, ODMs, IHVs), and other Canonical departments/teams.

Location : This role will be based remotely in the AMERICAs and/or EMEA regions.

Responsibilities

  • Managing projects through their complete life cycle and ensuring that the overall goals for both Canonical and the client are met
  • Successfully delivering engineering professional services for assigned projects
  • Working with engineering teams on custom board enablement and delivery of Ubuntu images to the customers
  • Assisting in the development of project statements of work
  • Drafting and maintaining project-specific schedules/project plans
  • Obtaining client agreement to the project schedule and agreed-upon work items
  • Ensuring projects are delivered within the time/resources/scope expectations
  • Managing project risk mitigation and plans
  • Driving technical issues to reach desired delivery outcomes
  • Maintain daily and weekly communication with the client and all internal stakeholders
  • Managing delivery schedule of critical third-party deliverables for the project
  • Keeping management informed of the status of assigned projects
  • Identifying custom engineering requests that are not part of an existing business contract
  • Advocating the appropriate technologies from Canonical's product portfolio to customers
  • Supporting different time zones and work non-traditional hours as required to support the assigned projects

What we are looking for in you

  • Solid project management experience in delivering engineering services to customers managing software development teams and field engineers
  • Extensive experience successfully managing projects with cross-cultural and multi-continent internal and external project resources, preferably with resources in Asia, Europe, and the Americas
  • Educational degree preferably in Science, Technology, Engineering, or Math
  • Good knowledge of Linux and the wider Open Source Software community, and understanding of computer architecture
  • Excellent communications skills, both verbal and written, in English
  • Strong leader and problem solver with extensive experience building successful internal and external partnerships and effective working relationships with demanding project sponsors in complex organizational environments
  • PMP/PMI or PRINCE2 Practitioner Certification preferred
  • Ability to work non-standard work hours in support of a worldwide sales and project team
  • Willingness to travel up to 4 times a year for internal events

What we offer colleagues

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

Benefits

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Job description

Desde dezembro de 2015, a SPDM/PAIS é responsável, em parceria com a Secretaria Municipal de Saúde do Rio de Janeiro, pelo gerenciamento do Hospital Municipal Pedro II .

A infraestrutura do Hospital conta com dez andares, nos quais estão distribuídos os serviços de emergência e de Unidade de Tratamento Intensivo (UTI) adulta, pediátrica e neonatal; maternidade; clínica médica, cirurgia-geral e bucomaxilofacial, neurocirurgia, psiquiatria, pediatria e ortopedia. Exames de imagem (raio X, tomografia, ultrassonografia, eletrocardiografia, ecocardiografia) e laboratoriais também são realizados na unidade.

Devido à grande população de idosos da Zona Oeste, região assistida pelo Hospital Municipal Pedro II (HMPII), há duas Enfermarias destinadas ao atendimento desse público.

O Centro de Tratamento de Queimados é outro diferencial entre os serviços oferecidos, e que dispõe de uma UTI exclusiva para prevenir infecções, que podem ser muito graves para quem está com queimaduras.

Além disso, a unidade conta com a Coordenação de Emergência Regional (CER) Santa Cruz, que possui 39 leitos, e tem como objetivo absorver as demandas de menor complexidade, deixando o HMPII liberado para os casos de risco iminente de morte, necessidade de cirurgia urgente e/ou internação. Um diferencial deste CER é o fato de possuir atendimento especializado em Psiquiatria e Obstetrícia.

Requirements and skills

Formação de acordo com a função exercida;

Experiência mínima de 06 (seis) meses comprovadas na área de atuação

Laudo médico válido e carimbado por médico especialista.

title: Senior Manager, Event Logistics FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027TM
description:
FIFA27 will be established as the Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil, to work together with FIFA HQ in Zurich and globally, to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ ("FWWC2027").

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

Job Description

The position

The Senior Manager Event Logistics ensures the most favorable conditions for the successful establishment & implementation of the Event Logistics project within the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™. The objective of the Event Logistics Project is the design and implementation of a robust supply chain which includes the infrastructure, to support the movement of goods between the host country venues, including stadiums, team base camps, training sites, the International Broadcast Centre, the Main Media Centre and other official sites.

Key responsibilities

  • Overall responsibility for the management, coordination and leadership of the Logistics team and sub-projects
  • International freight forwarding, including the international movement as well as customs clearance of goods into and out of the host country
  • Conception and implementation of simplified customs procedures together with the involved government authorities to ensure the smooth importation and exportation of goods for all tournament stakeholders
  • Central warehousing, including asset tracking not only within the warehouse but across all venues in which assets are provided by Logistics
  • Material planning, including the gathering of Furniture, Fixture and Equipment (FFE) requirements from all functional areas, working with Procurement in sourcing these requirements and delivery
  • Domestic distribution of FFE, FIFA assets, uniforms and other commodities; movements of team luggage and equipment to/from hotels, airports, stadiums and training sites and between host cities
  • Managing the entry to venues of delivery and collection vehicles during the tournament period via the Master Delivery Schedule System (MDS)
  • Providing Venue Logistics Services, including unloading/loading services, determining the storage space requirements of Logistics and other functional areas, distribution of items inside the venues, providing of FFE
  • Where/if required development of IT solutions for Master Delivery Schedule (MDS), Material Planning tool, Venue Delivery Portal (VDP) and Logistics Customer Relationship Management tool (LCRM)
  • Procurement and management of golf carts pool at venues
  • Development of a dissolution strategy, in cooperation with the tournament management, legal, procurement and all item procuring functional areas
  • Evaluation of the local logistics market and contracting a Logistics Service Provider (LSP) to provide warehousing, trucking, and people resources as required
  • Manage the established contracts (LSP, FFE- and golf carts provider) and ensure all project milestones, deadlines and KPIs are met
  • Provide the Logistics Concept of Operations and other project integration management documentation such as Functional Area Operational Plan (FAOP) and Standard Operational Plan (SOP) as required
  • Attend site/venue visits, workshops, logistics activities, meets and events in which an Event Logistics presence is required (e.g. Team Workshop, Broadcaster Meetings, Partnership Workshops)
  • Creation and management of the Event Logistics budget in cooperation with FIFA Zurich Event Logistics
  • Creation and management of the Event Logistics project plan, management (including mitigation) and communication of risks and issues in cooperation with FIFA Zurich Event Logistics
  • Recruitment of the Logistics team and providing leadership to this team
  • Prepare and manage a health- and safety plan
  • Prepare and manage a sustainability and environmental plan related to the Event Logistics Project
  • Provide timelines and accurate reporting to FIFA Zurich Event Logistics and Senior Management
  • Complete the final reconciliation, close the contracts and transfer the knowledge post-tournaments

Your profile

  • Minimum of 15 years of experience in Major Event Logistics, etc.
  • Knowledge of event logistics planning and event project management processes
  • Team player, willing to work to tight timelines
  • Strong analysis, reporting and data skills
  • Able to work in a fast-paced, multi-level, project-based event environment with emphasis on timelines and delivery
  • Positive attitude, patience, and persistence
  • Proven track record in managing complex projects, preferably international sports events
  • Right to work in Brazil
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to relocate to Rio de Janeiro

About FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027

The FIFA Women’s World Cup™ is the greatest women’s sporting event on the planet, showcasing the best players in the world on the biggest stage. In 2027, history will be made as Brazil welcomes the tournament to South America for the first time ever.

This landmark event will unite the world through an unprecedented celebration of women’s football, inspiring billions of fans across the globe. As we prepare to host teams and supporters from every corner of the world, we’re looking for passionate, talented individuals to be part of history and help deliver an unforgettable tournament.

Join us and play your role in making FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ a truly extraordinary experience that celebrates and elevates women’s football.

Job description

SPDM - Associação Paulista para o Desenvolvimento da Medicina é uma Associação civil sem fins lucrativos, de natureza filantrópica, reconhecida de utilidade pública federal, estadual e no município de sua sede, respectivamente pelos decretos nos. 57.925, de 04/03/1966, 40.103 de 17/05/1962 e 8.911, de 30/07/1970.

A Instituição atua nos âmbitos federal, estadual e municipal, em harmonia com suas políticas de saúde e de educação, e também como organização social habilitada em vários estados, na gerência de serviços e organizações de saúde, por meio de convênios e contratos de gestão.

A diretriz primordial da Associação é sua inserção no sistema de saúde direcionada ao tratamento, prevenção de doenças e à promoção da saúde primária, secundária e terciária, estreitando laços com a comunidade local e reafirmando seu compromisso social de atender a todos, sem discriminação.

Com o crescimento Institucional, a SPDM vem expandindo sua área de atuação com projetos, em desenvolvimento, na área da Assistência Social e na área Educacional. Toda essa gama de atividades consolida, cada vez mais, a SPDM como uma instituição filantrópica de grande porte, que busca a sustentabilidade econômica, social e ambiental.

Suas quatro superintendências - Hospital São Paulo, Instituições Afiliadas, Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde (PAIS) e Educação - são gerenciadas por profissionais de alta capacitação técnica e notável saber.

Main responsibilities

Promover ações de apoio matricial às equipes de saúde da família com o intuito de qualificar e ampliar o escopo de ações da atenção básica. Promover ações que propiciem a redução de incapacidades e deficiências com vistas à melhoria da qualidade de vida dos indivíduos, favorecendo sua reinserção social, combatendo a discriminação e ampliando o acesso ao sistema de saúde. Formular projetos terapêuticos únicos que considerem a pessoa, suas necessidades e o significado da deficiência no contexto familiar e social.
